dashboard.restartBody: Trying to restore the connection automatically. If that fails, turn protection on manually.
dashboard.competingBody: Two tunnels at once break DNS and the internet. Keep only one on: turn off either our protection or the other client (Happ TUN, WireGuard, OpenVPN and the like).
dashboard.leakBody: Turn protection on or check your VPN client. If protection is already on, the VPN server may be down.
dashboard.recheckFailed: Could not check the kill switch
dashboard.releaseFailed: Could not remove the kill switch

foreignVpn.title: Another VPN detected
foreignVpn.body: While it runs, pings are unreliable: its adapter intercepts the checks and answers for every server (hence the identical ~1–40 ms). Quit the other VPN completely (exit it from the tray) to see the real latencies.
